It’s called “First Drop 2026”! It’s adding new models for *all* the baby mobs! Like baby wolves, kittens, piglets, and even baby rabbits! 💖

And now you can make Name Tags! You need 1 Paper and 1 Metal Nugget to make them! Isn’t that cool? ✨

It’s coming out at the end of March! 🥳 Do you want to build a little house for all the baby animals? 🥰
